div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Note: The individuals identified below were principal participants in the events covered in this volume. Other officials and individuals not included in the list are identified in footnotes to the text at appropriate places. In general, individuals attending but not participating in meetings, and persons mentioned only in passing have not been identified. All titles and positions are American unless otherwise indicated. Where no dates are given, the individuals held the position throughout the period covered by this volume. Spelling and alphabetization of names follows as closely as possible the style of official publications of the countries concerned.
